function calcDrawTextOffset(idx, charsBefore, delay): number

Defined in: core/utils/wasm/wasm-layout.ts:176

Start-time offset for character idx: charsBefore·delay staggers it after the preceding run, plus idx·DRAW_INDEX_STEP_MS so later items in a list cascade even at equal char counts.

Parameters

idx

number

Index of this item/word in the sequence.

charsBefore

number

Cumulative characters before this item.

delay

number

Per-char delay from calcDrawTextDelay.

Returns

number

Start offset in ms.
